tools.name: send_ticket_delivery_email
tools.description: Emails a ticket holder their ticket codes and event details for a given event. The message goes to the attendee's email address through the box office mail server.

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Attendee email address to deliver the tickets to.

params.name: event_name
params.description: Name of the event shown in the email subject and body.

params.name: event_datetime
params.description: Human-readable event date and time, e.g. 'Sat, Nov 14 2026, 8:00 PM'.

params.name: ticket_codes
params.description: List of ticket barcode strings to include in the email.

tools.code:
import os
import smtplib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from email.message import EmailMessage

from langchain_core.tools import tool

SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("BOXOFFICE_SMTP_HOST", "smtp.boxoffice.internal")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("BOXOFFICE_SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("BOXOFFICE_SMTP_USER", "")
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("BOXOFFICE_SMTP_PASSWORD", "")
SENDER = os.environ.get("BOXOFFICE_SENDER", "tickets@boxoffice.example")


@dataclass
class DeliveryResult:
    recipient: str
    ticket_count: int
    sent: bool
    errors: list = field(default_factory=list)


@tool
def send_ticket_delivery_email(recipient_email: str, event_name: str, event_datetime: str, ticket_codes: list) -> dict:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = recipient_email
    msg["Subject"] = f"Your tickets for {event_name}"
    lines = [f"Event: {event_name}", f"When: {event_datetime}", "", "Your ticket codes:"]
    lines.extend(f"  - {code}" for code in ticket_codes)
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Present these codes at the gate for entry.")
    msg.set_content("\n".join(lines))
    result = DeliveryResult(recipient=recipient_email, ticket_count=len(ticket_codes), sent=False)
    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, timeout=20) as server:
            server.starttls()
            if SMTP_USER:
                server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
            server.send_message(msg)
        result.sent = True
    except smtplib.SMTPException as exc:
        result.errors.append(str(exc))
    return result.__dict__

tools.name: get_event_seat_availability
tools.description: Looks up an event and reports how many seats are sold, held, and still available in each pricing section.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to look up.

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@tool
def get_event_seat_availability(event_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    event = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, name, venue, starts_at FROM events WHERE id = ?",
        (event_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT s.section_name, s.price_cents, s.capacity,
               SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sold,
               SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'held' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS held
        FROM sections s
        LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.section_id = s.id
        WHERE s.event_id = ?
        GROUP BY s.id
        ORDER BY s.price_cents DESC
        """,
        (event_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    sections = [
        {**dict(r), "available": r["capacity"] - (r["sold"] or 0) - (r["held"] or 0)}
        for r in rows
    ]
    return {
        "event": dict(event) if event else None,
        "sections": sections,
        "total_available": sum(s["available"] for s in sections),
    }

tools.name: purge_expired_seat_holds
tools.description: Finds seat holds for an event whose checkout window has expired and permanently deletes them, returning the released seats to the pool. Returns the list of holds that were removed.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event whose expired holds should be cleared.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "ticketing.db"


@tool
def purge_expired_seat_holds(event_id: int) -> dict:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    expired = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, seat_id, customer_ref, expires_at FROM seat_holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < ?",
        (event_id, now),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM seat_holds WHERE event_id = ? AND expires_at < ?", (event_id, now))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    removed = [{"hold_id": r[0], "seat_id": r[1], "customer_ref": r[2], "expired_at": r[3]} for r in expired]
    return {"event_id": event_id, "removed_count": len(removed), "removed": removed}
